editorial: While open source code review tools and modern web development guides are coming to the forefront in the software world today, next-generation visual models and multi-user memory architectures are drawing attention on the artificial intelligence side. Efforts to break cloud dependency at the hardware level and system outages in the aviation sector provide important data regarding the fragility of technological infrastructures.

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.summary: Developed by Alibaba, open-code-review offers a hybrid architecture that combines deterministic pipelines and large language models (LLMs) to automate code review processes. The tool uses multilingual rule sets to detect security vulnerabilities while providing the ability to comment at the line level.

snapshot.description: Secure, fast, efficient, battle-tested at Alibaba's scale. Hybrid architecture code review tool: deterministic pipelines + LLM Agent, precise line-level comments, built-in multi-language ruleset (NPE, thread-safety, XSS, SQL injection), OpenAI & Anthropic compatible.

items.title: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src
items.summary: GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance-src is a resource repository aimed at keeping coding agents aligned with current web development standards and best practices. Prepared in the TypeScript language, this project provides the necessary code and documentation for the creation, calibration, and evaluation of content.

snapshot.description: Keep your coding agent up to date with the latest web best practices. This repo is the source repository for GoogleChrome/modern-web-guidance and includes the code and documentation for authoring, calibrating, and evaluating its contents.

items.title: openai/codex-security
items.summary: Developed by OpenAI, codex-security offers a command-line interface (CLI) designed to find, verify, and remediate security vulnerabilities, as well as a suite of tools (SDK) that facilitates application development for programmers. Written in TypeScript, this tool aims to automate security audits in software development processes.

snapshot.description: OpenAI's Codex Security CLI and TypeScript SDK for finding, validating, and fixing security vulnerabilities. npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@openai/codex-security

items.title: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis
items.summary: ZhuLinsen/daily_stock_analysis is a stock market tracking system that analyzes multi-market data and current news using large language models (LLMs). While the software offers a dashboard for investment decisions, it also provides automatic notifications and free scheduled execution capabilities.

snapshot.description: LLM 驱动的多市场股票智能分析系统：多源行情、实时新闻、决策看板与自动推送，支持零成本定时运行。 LLM-powered multi-market stock analysis system with multi-source market data, real-time news, decision dashboard, automated notifications, and cost-free scheduled runs.

items.title: we-promise/sure
items.summary: Developed in the Ruby language, sure is an application project that aims to make personal finance and asset management processes accessible to everyone. Based on the infrastructure of the abandoned Maybe Finance project, this work offered features that allowed users to connect with financial advisors.

snapshot.description: The personal finance app for everyone (by everyone). The Maybe Finance (archived/abandoned repo) team spent most of 2021–2022 building a full-featured personal finance and wealth management app. It even included an “Ask an Advisor” feature that connected users with a real CFP/CFA — all included with your subscription.

items.title: backnotprop/plannotator
items.summary: plannotator is a platform that combines planning, code review, and feedback processes for artificial intelligence agents into a single workspace. Developed with TypeScript, this tool allows teams to manage their interactions with agents and transfer feedback directly to the agents.

snapshot.description: The workspace to stay in the loop and on top of agents - shape, decide, plan, annotate, review code, share with team, and send all feedback to agents with one click.

items.title: louislam/uptime-kuma
items.summary: Uptime Kuma is a monitoring tool with a visual interface that you can host on your own server. This JavaScript-based application, which allows you to track the operational status of websites and services, offers a user-friendly experience.

snapshot.description: A fancy self-hosted monitoring tool. Uptime Kuma is an easy-to-use self-hosted monitoring tool.

items.title: block/buzz
items.summary: Developed by Block, Buzz is a communication platform where humans and artificial intelligence agents coexist in the same workspaces. Written in Rust, this self-hostable project aims to provide a collaborative work environment.

snapshot.description: A hive mind communication platform. Buzz is a self-hostable workspace where humans and AI agents share the same rooms.

items.title: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills
items.summary: tradermonty/claude-trading-skills offers Claude Code skills that automate processes such as market analysis, technical charts, and strategy development for stock investors and traders. Prepared in the Python language, this project aims to support financial data processing with economic calendar and browser tools.

snapshot.description: Claude Code skills for equity investors and traders — market analysis, technical charting, economic calendars, screeners, and trading strategy development.

items.title: tailscale/tailcat
items.summary: Developed by Tailscale, tailcat is a version of the netcat tool used to monitor and route network traffic, running on the Tailscale data plane. This open source software allows for the creation of WireGuard-encrypted tunnels between two machines without the need for the Tailscale control plane.

snapshot.description: like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane. Tailcat is a remix of Tailscale open source pieces to act like netcat, but over Tailscale's data plane, without Tailscale's control plane. Tailscale's data plane (magicsock, internally) gives you point-to-point WireGuard®-encrypted tunnels between two machines with DERP as the NAT-hole-punching communication side channel and the ultimate relay-of-last-resort if NAT traversal fails.

items.title: Likely7/Veyra-NRVideo
items.summary: Veyra-NRVideo is an advanced Windows video player and recording enhancement tool that offers real-time preview for videos and image sources. It aims to improve the visual experience by using AI-powered super resolution, image enhancement, and frame generation technologies.

snapshot.description: Bring PS5 GTA6 to 120FPS with DLSS 5. An advanced Windows video player and capture enhancement tool featuring real-time preview for videos, images, and capture card sources. Combine AI-powered Super Resolution, DLSS5 image enhancement, and Frame Generation to deliver a next-generation visual experience.

items.title: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp
items.summary: ChromeDevTools/chrome-devtools-mcp allows coding agents (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor, or Copilot) to inspect and control a live Chrome browser. Offered as a Model Context Protocol server and command-line interface, this tool provides AI assistants with access to browser tools for debugging and performance analysis.

snapshot.description: Chrome DevTools for coding agents. Chrome DevTools for agents (chrome-devtools-mcp) lets your coding agent (such as Antigravity, Claude, Cursor or Copilot) control and inspect a live Chrome browser. It is available as a Model-Context-Protocol (MCP) server and as a CLI. Both give your AI coding assistant access to the full power of Chrome DevTools for reliable automation, in-depth debugging, and performance analysis.

items.title: FAA issues national ground stop – lifted 4.5 hours later
items.summary: The U.S. Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) decided to ground all departures nationwide for safety reasons. The flight ban in question was lifted after approximately 4.5 hours.

snapshot.description: https://www.fly.faa.gov/adv/adv_otherdis?adv_date=11132026&a...https://www.fly.faa.gov/adv/adv_otherdis?adv_date=11142026&a...https://www.nytimes.com/live/2026/11/13/us/ground-stop-natio...

items.title: Reverse engineering my Coway air purifier to ditch the cloud
items.summary: The user reverse-engineered the Coway Airmega air purifier to eliminate reliance on cloud-based services. This study details the technical processes that allow the device to be controlled over a local network.

snapshot.description: The year is 2017. A string of annual wildfires rocks the West Coast. The sky looks like this in the daytime: My home, like many in the Bay Area, has no insulation and isn’t really air sealed. To avoid choking on soot, a lot of people started buying air purifiers like this one: The venerable Coway Airmega

items.title: AI unlocks Gödel's notebooks, said to contain hundreds of proved theorems
items.summary: Artificial intelligence technology is being used to analyze 1,009 pages of notes left by mathematician Kurt Gödel, written in an old shorthand system. This study reveals that the notes contain hundreds of proven theorems.

snapshot.description: Kurt Gödel left 1,009 pages of densely written text – much of it in an obsolete shorthand – which is now said to contain hundreds of proved theorems

items.title: $11.4M in Nvidia hardware vanishes during shipment from CA to TX
items.summary: It has been reported that $11.4 million worth of Nvidia hardware, being shipped from California to Texas, went missing during transit. While Oakland police have launched an investigation into the theft, there is no clear information yet regarding the identity of the shipping company or the process of the disappearance.

snapshot.description: Oakland police confirmed a grand theft investigation involving a shipment reportedly worth $11.4 million. The carrier's identity and circumstances surrounding the disappearance remain unclear.

items.title: Live airband on all frequencies from KORS. Victoria, CA also ground stopped
items.summary: Orcas Airband, which allows for live listening, transcription, and archiving of all aviation radio broadcasts over Orcas Island, WA, also tracks flight restrictions in the Victoria, CA area. Users can listen to all channels simultaneously or rewind and review past broadcasts to any desired moment.

snapshot.description: Every aviation radio transmission heard from Orcas Island, WA: live, transcribed, and archived. Listen to all channels at once, pick your own, or rewind to any moment.

items.title: xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic
items.summary: Shared on Hugging Face, xtools-at/DeepSeek-V4-Pro-Qwen3.5-9B-UNCENSORED-heretic is an AI model focused on text generation. The developer also offers the xtools-at/Qwen3.5-9B-DeepThought-STEM project, a fine-tuned version with scientific content upon which this model is based.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. Also check out DeepThought, my science finetune based on this model: xtools-at/Qwen3.5-9B-DeepThought-STEM

items.title: MiniMaxAI/MiniMax-H3-Image
items.summary: MiniMax-H3-Image, offered by MiniMaxAI, is an AI model with text-to-image generation capabilities. The software provides API (digital bridge between software) documentation in two different languages for image editing and prompt expansion functions.

snapshot.description: text-to-image model. API docs: - Text-to-image: EN-docs, CN-docs - Image editing: EN-docs, CN-docs - Prompt expansion: EN-docs, CN-docs

items.title: Lightricks/LTX-2.5
items.summary: LTX-2.5, developed by Lightricks, is an image-to-video AI model that converts images into moving videos. Accessible via the Hugging Face platform, this model is used to create animated versions of visual content.

snapshot.description: image-to-video model

items.title: NousResearch/Arete-27B
items.summary: Arete-27B, developed by NousResearch, is an AI model trained on Alibaba's text-generation model Qwen3.8-27B. This work aims to reinforce Western values by applying post-training to a China-based model.

snapshot.description: text-generation model. We post-trained over Alibaba's Qwen3.8-27B to reinforce western values on a Chinese-trained model. We call this new model Arete-27B.

items.title: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B
items.summary: Qwen/Qwen3.8-27B, published on Hugging Face, is an AI model capable of converting visual and text inputs into text outputs. Introduced as the most capable version of the Qwen open model family, this model aims to continue the success of previous versions adopted by the community.

snapshot.description: image-text-to-text model. Following the widespread community adoption of the Qwen3.5 and Qwen3.6 series, we are pleased to introduce Qwen3.8, the most capable generation in the Qwen open-model family to date.

items.title: Who Remembers What? Multi-Granularity Memory Extraction for Multi-User, Multi-Agent Interaction
items.summary: The article published on Hugging Face introduces the MixUA system, which manages memory sharing in multi-user and multi-agent environments. The system parses information obtained from interactions between users and large language models (LLMs) and shares it among agents within the framework of privacy rules.

snapshot.description: Self-evolving agents improve their own skills, memory, and harness code from experience without retraining the base LLM, and group-evolving agents go further by sharing these lessons across agents. Yet most such systems overlook that sharing across users and heterogeneous agents requires deciding who can benefit from each lesson and what information must remain private. items.title: EgoX: Egocentric Cross-Embodiment Manipulation with Embodiment Dreaming
items.summary: EgoX, shared by Hugging Face, is a learning framework that aims to bridge the experience gap between humans and robots with different physical structures and control interfaces. The system enables the development of robotic manipulation policies by organizing heterogeneous representations through semantically matched observation and action modalities.

snapshot.description: Generalist manipulation policies can benefit from the complementary experience of humans, real robots, and simulated agents. However, differences in morphology, sensing, and control interfaces make it difficult to learn effectively from their combined demonstrations. We introduce EgoX, an egocentric cross-embodiment learning framework that organizes heterogeneous demonstrations through semantically corresponding observation and action modalities. items.title: Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space
items.summary: The paper 'Back to Pixels: Lifting Latent Video Diffusion into Pixel Space' addresses the limitations of latent space compression used in video generation models regarding the creation of high-resolution and interactive content. The method, called PixVid, aims to overcome these limitations by moving pre-trained latent video models directly into pixel space.

snapshot.description: Frontier video generation models work in a VAE latent space that compresses video in both space and time. This compression made training tractable, but now limits high-resolution, controllable, and interactive generation -- doubling resolution quadruples token count, conditions apply to groups of frames rather than individual ones, and each response must wait for the rest of its multi-frame block. items.title: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes
items.summary: Consensus Capture in Reference-Based UAV Video Stabilization: A Benchmark on Dynamic Urban Scenes is a study that examines the erroneous matches caused by moving objects in image stabilization processes for unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) videos. The research presents a new benchmark to evaluate the impact of dynamic movements in urban areas on reference-frame-based stabilization methods.

snapshot.description: Reference-frame stabilization registers every frame of a hovering-drone video onto one reference frame, keeping object positions comparable. The registration pipelines it relies on are selected on feature-matching benchmarks in which only the camera moves. Over a busy intersection, vehicles moving together supply mutually consistent correspondences that can draw the robust homography estimate toward their motion: consensus capture, which inlier statistics cannot flag. items.title: TurtLES: A Large-Scale Benchmark for Turbulent 3D Neural PDE Surrogates
items.summary: TurtLES is a large-scale dataset prepared for artificial intelligence models developed to accelerate computational fluid dynamics processes. Including 3D turbulent flows, this study provides a benchmark tool to measure the performance of models with realistic and time-dependent data.

snapshot.description: Machine-learning surrogates are increasingly used to accelerate computational fluid dynamics, yet progress is limited by the lack of benchmarks capturing realistic, time-dependent turbulent flows. We introduce TurtLES, a 14 TB dataset of 3D turbulent cylinder wakes in the shear-layer transition regime, computed via high-fidelity implicit large-eddy simulations. glossary.explanation: These are workflows that allow the steps in a software process to follow one another and occur automatically.
These are artificial intelligence models trained on massive amounts of data that can understand human language and generate text.
These are artificial intelligence software that autonomously perform tasks such as writing, debugging, or editing code in software development processes.
It is a text-based interface that runs programs with written commands rather than with a mouse.
It is a set of ready-made tools and libraries that make it easier for developers to build applications for a specific platform or system.
These are software programs that can be run on the user's own computer or server without the need for a third-party server.
These are specialized capabilities or functions acquired by artificial intelligence models to perform operations in a specific field.
It is the fundamental infrastructure layer where data on a network is actually transmitted and routed.
Software whose source code is open for anyone to inspect, modify, and share.
It is a technology that makes low-resolution images clearer and higher-resolution with the help of artificial intelligence.
It is a method of inserting new frames between existing frames using artificial intelligence to make the image flow smoother.
It is a communication protocol that allows artificial intelligence models to connect to different data sources and tools in a standard way.
It is the official agency that regulates and oversees civil aviation in the United States.
It is the process of taking a device or software apart to understand how it works and to analyze its operating logic.
It is the ability to generate meaningful text in accordance with given commands or context.
It is the retraining of a pre-trained artificial intelligence model with a smaller and more specific dataset to make it more successful in a particular subject.
